Linear table of slope 2 pi; zero-lift angle and quarter-chord moment coefficient read from the Makani XFOIL table of mp6d at zero lift, because the mp6d contour is not among the retained sources (the other surfaces use the thin-airfoil integral of their mean lines)

base_provenance.model_difference: Physical section rotation and mean-surface geometry; AVL uses normal-vector incidence. Not an AVL solver reproduction.

pylons.discretisation: equal panel heights; leading edge, chord and installation angle interpolated linearly in height along the eleven AVL sections; physical section rotation
pylons.cowling_sections: given the mp6d section data (the hover model treats a pylon as one mp6d panel)
pylons.junction: pylons and wing are separate lifting surfaces; their junction is not modelled
